facts.text: close() sends a disconnect message but does not explicitly stop the background thread.
receive() blocks on _send_queue.get(), which could keep the thread alive if the application doesn't exit on disconnect.

root_cause_hypotheses.text: The application running in the background thread may not terminate upon receiving a disconnect message, causing the thread to persist.
The anyio portal used to start the task may not be properly cancelled when close() is called, leaving the thread running.

unresolved_questions: Does the background thread exit after close() is called in practice?

def test_client_close(test_client_factory: Callable[..., TestClient]):
    close_code = None
    close_reason = None

    async def app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
        nonlocal close_code, close_reason
        websocket = WebSocket(scope, receive=receive, send=send)
        await websocket.accept()
        try:
            await websocket.receive_text()
        except WebSocketDisconnect as exc:
            close_code = exc.code
            close_reason = exc.reason

    client = test_client_factory(app)
    with client.websocket_connect("/") as websocket:
        websocket.close(code=status.WS_1001_GOING_AWAY, reason="Going Away")
    assert close_code == status.WS_1001_GOING_AWAY
    assert close_reason == "Going Away"

def test_websocket_close_reason(test_client_factory: Callable[..., TestClient]) -> None:
    async def app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
        websocket = WebSocket(scope, receive=receive, send=send)
        await websocket.accept()
        await websocket.close(code=status.WS_1001_GOING_AWAY, reason="Going Away")

    client = test_client_factory(app)
    with client.websocket_connect("/") as websocket:
        with pytest.raises(WebSocketDisconnect) as exc:
            websocket.receive_text()
        assert exc.value.code == status.WS_1001_GOING_AWAY
        assert exc.value.reason == "Going Away"

def test_websocket_endpoint_on_disconnect(test_client_factory):
    class WebSocketApp(WebSocketEndpoint):
        async def on_disconnect(self, websocket, close_code):
            assert close_code == 1001
            await websocket.close(code=close_code)

    client = test_client_factory(WebSocketApp)
    with client.websocket_connect("/ws") as websocket:
        websocket.close(code=1001)

def test_application_close(test_client_factory: Callable[..., TestClient]):
    async def app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
        websocket = WebSocket(scope, receive=receive, send=send)
        await websocket.accept()
        await websocket.close(status.WS_1001_GOING_AWAY)

    client = test_client_factory(app)
    with client.websocket_connect("/") as websocket:
        with pytest.raises(WebSocketDisconnect) as exc:
            websocket.receive_text()
        assert exc.value.code == status.WS_1001_GOING_AWAY
